verdict: Afterglow is held with real discipline: one typeface, ember appears only as light and the fluff underline (44 ember uses, the only other chroma is X's own link blue inside X cards and the Google mark in the sheet), the hooked-h wordmark and app tile are consistent from nav to notification to sheet to footer, and the struck-fluff underline has become a genuine brand device that carries personality into headings, FAQ and Studio. Nothing I would change is visible in the first five seconds of any section at 1440 or 390; what is left is small polish.

issues.where: Pricing heading 'Sharpening is free. / Forever.' (1440 and 390)
issues.problem: Every other section heading uses the two-tone voice (one line soft white, one line grey). This is the only display heading set fully white, so the system reads as broken for one section rather than deliberately emphatic.
issues.fix: Set 'Forever.' in the same grey as the other second lines (or grey 'Sharpening is free.' and keep 'Forever.' white, mirroring the hero). Do not add ember.

issues.problem: Tracking is at the limit: word gaps in 'They read one line.' close up so the line reads slightly as one mass, and 'rt'/'hy' pairs in 'hookworthy.' nearly touch. The 72px headings at -0.042em are fine.
issues.fix: Ease the H1 to about -0.040em at 1440 or add word-spacing of 0.04em; keep the two-line break.

issues.where: Studio card, photo inside Priya's post (laptops and pizza)
issues.problem: It is the one image that feels like generic stock rather than Afterglow: cooler and muddier than the ember-lit desk and sunrise crops, and soft at about 475px wide from the 800px sprite.
issues.fix: Reduce it to a shorter crop (about 96px tall strip at 1440, same as the 390 treatment which already drops it) and apply the same warm grade/dark overlay used on the 11 PM desk image, or crop tighter on the lit laptop so the softness is hidden.

issues.where: Try box result, 'Why it hits' column at 1440 after a custom line
issues.problem: The explanation wraps raggedly with a short widow-like line ('to announce" went, so the / line opens on ...'), which looks unset next to the tight post card.
issues.fix: Add text-wrap: pretty (or balance) to the Why it hits paragraph and let the column take a max-width of about 30ch so quoted fragments do not break mid-phrase.

issues.problem: The heading sits hard left with the billing toggle marooned far right and a large empty field between; it is the least composed header on a page whose other sections are tightly framed in glass.
issues.fix: Bring the toggle to sit on the baseline of 'Pay for volume, never for the basics.' directly beside it (or under it, left-aligned), so heading, sub and toggle read as one group.
